import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_stencil_loss_b()
    return nothing
end

function stencil_loss_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, i_n)
    for i_x = 2:i_n - 1
        w[i_x] = (u[i_x - 1] - 2.0 * u[i_x]) + u[i_x + 1]
    end
    for i_seq_x = 2:i_n - 1
        loss[1] = loss[1] + w[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    end
    for i_seq_x = i_n - 1:-1:2
        wb[i_seq_x] = wb[i_seq_x] + (2 * w[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    end
    for i_x = 2:i_n - 1
        ub[i_x - 1] = ub[i_x - 1] + wb[i_x]
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + 2.0 * -(wb[i_x])
        ub[i_x + 1] = ub[i_x + 1] + wb[i_x]
        wb[i_x] = 0.0
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_stencil_loss_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function stencil_loss_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, w, wb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_1!(i_n, u, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_2!(i_n, loss, w)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(2 - (i_n - 1), -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_3!(i_n, lossb, w, wb)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_4!(i_n, ub, wb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_1!(i_n, u, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 2 + (__tid - 1)
    w[i_x] = (u[i_x - 1] - 2.0 * u[i_x]) + u[i_x + 1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_2!(i_n, loss, w)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = 2 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += w[i_seq_x] ^ 2
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_3!(i_n, lossb, w, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(2 - (i_n - 1), -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_seq_x = (i_n - 1) + (__tid - 1) * -1
    wb[i_seq_x] = wb[i_seq_x] + (2 * w[i_seq_x]) * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_stencil_loss_b_4!(i_n, ub, wb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div((i_n - 1) - 2, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 2 + (__tid - 1)
    ub[i_x - 1] = ub[i_x - 1] + wb[i_x]
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + 2.0 * -(wb[i_x])
    ub[i_x + 1] = ub[i_x + 1] + wb[i_x]
    wb[i_x] = 0.0
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 3
__base_loss = Float64[-1.0834131243613363, 0.7310317368299118, -0.414263048543018, 0.21952143498559645]
__base_u = Float64[-0.5338250023122001, 1.4222838742507766, 0.48286276618257845, 0.9737002361342241]
__base_w = Float64[-1.2067293610686962, -0.09001597664818363, 0.1691514845771776, 1.0905808501281673]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.957654821363475, -0.3251598313965054, -0.11755145124177763, 0.0806428172585313], Float64[-0.3092743821118848, 0.747288621154352, 1.6228398859980162, 0.33518958402626786]]
__seed_u = [Float64[-1.0352126460058397, -0.11393789331427218, 1.7344871434030031, 0.21436590779634865], Float64[0.24606529748515288, -0.48073802758394474, 1.1326547555840514, 1.992759351730707]]
__seed_w = [Float64[1.3676125494095293, 0.28070958872541524, 0.26681958577919607, 0.32161302321807356], Float64[-1.9421043641910531, 0.4374953652023737, 0.6100912054326182, -0.09703458790438724]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:2
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  w_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_w); w_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial])
  w_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_w)); w_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_w[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_stencil_loss_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_stencil_loss_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = stencil_loss_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, w_val_cpu, w_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = stencil_loss_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, w_val_gpu, w_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(w_sh_cpu, Array(w_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(w_val_cpu, Array(w_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
